panels.title: Memory nodes (hostname, node ID, addresses, build)

targets.expr: sum by (instance,node_id) (rate(miracache_lookup_keys_total{result="hit", node_id=~"$node_id"}[5m])) / sum by (instance,node_id) (rate(miracache_lookup_keys_total{node_id=~"$node_id"}[5m])) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Lookup keys/s per memory node (hit + miss)

targets.expr: sum by (instance,node_id,result) (rate(miracache_lookup_keys_total{node_id=~"$node_id"}[5m])) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Fetch latency p50 / p99 (client-measured, end to end; targets in spec section 12)
Put commit latency p50 / p99 per memory node

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le,instance,node_id) (rate(miracache_put_commit_seconds_bucket{node_id=~"$node_id"}[5m]))) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le,instance,node_id) (rate(miracache_put_commit_seconds_bucket{node_id=~"$node_id"}[5m]))) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Bytes put per second per memory node (by result)

targets.expr: sum by (instance,node_id,result) (rate(miracache_put_bytes_total{node_id=~"$node_id"}[5m])) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Bytes fetched per second (client-measured, by result)
Store bytes by state per memory node

targets.expr: sum by (instance,node_id,state) (miracache_store_bytes{node_id=~"$node_id"}) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}
sum by (instance,node_id) (miracache_scope_open{node_id=~"$node_id"}) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Evicted bytes per second by reason

targets.expr: sum by (instance,node_id,reason) (rate(miracache_evict_bytes_total{node_id=~"$node_id"}[5m])) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Errors per memory node: failed requests, refused puts, digest mismatches, admin rejects

targets.expr: sum by (instance,node_id,op) (rate(miracache_requests_total{status="error", node_id=~"$node_id"}[5m])) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}

sum by (instance,node_id,reason) (rate(miracache_put_refused_total{node_id=~"$node_id"}[5m])) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}

sum by (instance,node_id) (rate(miracache_put_digest_mismatch_total{node_id=~"$node_id"}[5m])) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}

sum by (instance,node_id,reason) (rate(miracache_admin_conn_rejected_total{node_id=~"$node_id"}[5m])) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}

panels.title: Leases: active, granted/s, expired/s per memory node

targets.expr: sum by (instance,node_id) (miracache_lease_active{node_id=~"$node_id"}) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}
sum by (instance,node_id) (rate(miracache_lease_expired_total{node_id=~"$node_id"}[5m])) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}
sum by (instance,node_id,principal) (miracache_principal_bytes{node_id=~"$node_id"}) * on(instance,node_id) group_left(hostname) miracache_node_info{node_id=~"$node_id", hostname=~"$hostname"}
